name: Mammon
overview: The Scriptures clearly teach that mammon, representing wealth or riches, cannot be served alongside God, as one will inevitably love one master and despise the other (Matthew 6:24; Luke 16:13). Jesus warns believers to be faithful with mammon, the unrighteous riches, as a test of their trustworthiness for true, eternal riches (Luke 16:9, 11). Thus, mammon is portrayed not merely as money but as a rival master that demands exclusive allegiance, challenging believers to prioritize God above material wealth.
